dft.text: Muraganda is where the race arrives when an Omenpath opens at the end of the Amonkhet track, and Spitfire is awed by its giant flowers and suspended rain. Its jungle is dangerous, as giant oaks crash down onto the course and a moonfall quake sends the racers scrambling for shelter.

The raider Tyrox sets up ambushes along the track to capture its technology and seize power without the Autocracy's approval, and a giant dinosaur carrying a fortress and a dozen mounted lizardman raiders attacks the trapped racers. The raiders capture Daretti and Loot to be sacrificed, until Pia picks the lock and Chandra's fireball blows up half the camp as they escape.

Elsewhere on the plane the Fang Druid Chatal appears to Khrad, tells him that the world is larger than he realizes, and gives him a fire amulet that grants mastery over his vehicle. Chandra, following Loot's cue, steers into a tree whose bark falls away to reveal an Omenpath, and they crash across the border into a different world.
